metadata.title: Cancer incidence by census block group, 2011-2015 (NYS DOH Cancer Mapping)
metadata.source: NYS Department of Health, New York State Cancer Registry, 'Cancer Mapping Data: 2011-2015', health.data.ny.gov dataset y4pv-ib8r (published 2018-08-17; cancer data provisional as of December 2017)
metadata.geography: 2010 census block groups; some merged by DOH (geoid contains 'DOH', members in merged_geoid10). Geometry: TIGER/Line 2010 block groups, clipped to CD1.
metadata.selection: DOH regions with more than 50% of their land area (ALAND10) inside CD1 (BoroCD 301)
metadata.suppression: No values are suppressed. To protect confidentiality DOH merged neighbouring block groups until each area had at least 6 male and 6 female cancer cases in total (12 cases if all one sex, e.g. prisons).

fields.total_population: DOH total_pop: average population 2011-2015 estimated from the 2010 census by iterative proportional fitting to county estimates
fields.obs: observed newly diagnosed cases, 2011-2015 (all primaries counted)
fields.exp: expected cases if New York State age- and sex-specific rates applied to the area's population (rounded to 2 decimals)
fields.ratio: observed / expected (2 decimals); null if expected is 0
fields.sig: DOH highlight flag: 'higher' / 'lower' = block group lies in a DOH highlighted area (spatial scan statistic, >=50% excess or deficit, unlikely to be chance) for that cancer; 'not significant' = not in a highlighted area. It describes the whole multi-block-group area, not this block group alone. Null where DOH publishes no flag (all, other).

cancers.all: All cancers combined (the 23 sites plus all other reportable cancers)
cancers.nasal: Nasal cavity and nasopharynx (nasopharynx, nose, nasal cavity and middle ear)
cancers.oral: Oral cavity and pharynx, excluding nasopharynx
